title: Site coefficients and risk-targeted maximum considered earthquake (MCE ) spectral response acceleration parameters.
officialText:
R The MCE spectral response acceleration parameters for short periods, S , and at 1-second period, S , adjusted for site class effects shall R MS M1 be determined by Equations 16-47 and 16-48, respectively:

S = F S (Equation 16-47) MS a S S = F S (Equation 16-48) M1 v 1 where:

F = Site coefficient defined in Table 1613.5.3(1). a F = Site coefficient defined in Table 1613.5.3(2). v S = The mapped MCE spectral accelerations for short periods as determined in Section 1613.5.1. S R S = The mapped MCE spectral accelerations for a 1-second period as determined in Section 1613.5.1. 1 R
